title: Combining boxplots with participant dots
description: You can follow two samples into summary boxes and individual markers.

steps.description: You create one axis and draw two labeled boxplots. The supplied arrays remain separate as Design A and Design B.
The loop assigns positions 1 and 2 to the groups. You generate one small horizontal offset for every observation.

steps.question: Does jitter change each marker's vertical data value?
steps.answer: No. It changes the x position, while data supplies the unchanged y values.

steps.description: You overlay participant markers, label the axis and call show. The supplied recording contains no figure or text output from which to read sample comparisons.
